meta.guide: 2026 MICHELIN Guide Southwest (Las Vegas selection), published August 2026 — first Vegas guide since 2009
meta.price_basis: 'Cost for 2' = dinner for two adults, food only, before tax and tip, built from verified menu/menu-page prices. Where no price could be verified, the field is null and the row is flagged.

legend.star: Michelin Star(s) — awarded by MICHELIN inspectors
legend.bib: Bib Gourmand — good quality, good value cooking (guide criterion: two courses + drink/dessert around $50 before tax/tip)
legend.recommended: Listed in the MICHELIN Guide (MICHELIN Selected / recommended) — no star, no Bib

restaurants.name: Restaurant de Joël Robuchon
restaurants.hours: CONFLICTING SOURCES — (a) smartervegas: Thu–Mon 5:00–9:30pm, closed Tue–Wed; (b) hotelmenuguide (citing official MGM page): Tue–Sat 5:00–9:30pm, closed Sun–Mon; (c) Las Vegas Advisor: Mon–Sun 5:30–10pm. Verify on MGM's site before booking.
restaurants.cost_2_adults_usd: 1,000–1,800 (16-course dégustation ~$525 pp Oct 2026 third-party; shorter tasting low-$200s pp; with modest pairing, tax, 20% tip)
restaurants.notes: Only 2-star restaurant in Las Vegas. Prices not published by restaurant — third-party figures dated Oct 2026.

restaurants.name: L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon
restaurants.hours: Dinner Mon, Thu–Sun 5:00–9:00pm; closed Tue–Wed (OpenTable official listing, Oct 2026). Tripadvisor agrees closed Tue–Wed.
restaurants.cost_2_adults_usd: 450–550 (Menu Découverte tasting ~$225–275 pp; à la carte $28–65 pp)
restaurants.notes: Counter seating sibling of Joël Robuchon next door.

restaurants.name: Guy Savoy
restaurants.address: 3570 S Las Vegas Blvd (Caesars Palace, Augustus Tower)
restaurants.hours: Dinner Tue–Sat 5:00pm–8:45pm last seating (OpenTable official listing, Aug 2026). SmarterVegas lists 5:00–9:00pm. Closed Sun–Mon.
restaurants.cost_2_adults_usd: 400–900+ à la carte (verified items: artichoke-truffle soup $100, caviar $120, sea bass $160, A5 wagyu $290, cheese $60); Symphony tasting $1,000 pp incl. premium pairing; Krug Chef's Table $1,500 pp
restaurants.notes: Menu dated 5 Nov 2026 (per Caesars). Forbes Five-Star 14th consecutive year (Feb 2026).

restaurants.name: é by José Andrés
restaurants.address: 3708 S Las Vegas Blvd, Level 3, Boulevard Tower (Cosmopolitan)
restaurants.hours: OFFICIAL (ebyjoseandres.com, fetched 2026-11-25): open Tuesday through Sunday, two shows per night at 5:30 PM and 8:30 PM; closed Monday. Resolves earlier Sun-conflict (B2).
restaurants.cost_2_adults_usd: 600–800 food only (~$300s pp tasting, 2026); ~$1,000–1,300 total for 2 with pairing, 20% gratuity, tax
restaurants.notes: Nine-seat prepaid ticketed counter inside Jaleo (official site); tickets released 3 months in advance, waitlist if sold out; official booking link on site. Hardest reservation in town.

restaurants.name: China Poblano
restaurants.address: 3708 S Las Vegas Blvd, Boulevard Tower Level 2 (Cosmopolitan)
restaurants.hours: SmarterVegas (Nov 2026): Mon–Thu 11:00am–10:00pm, Fri 11:00am–10:30pm, Sat 10:00am–10:30pm, Sun 10:00am–10:00pm. OpenTable: Mon–Fri 11:00am–10:00pm, Sat–Sun 10:00am–10:30pm. Minor weekend conflicts — flagged.
restaurants.cost_2_adults_usd: 60–120 (OpenTable $31–50 pp; José's Way tasting menu $60 pp per Tripadvisor menu)
restaurants.notes: Chinese-Mexican by José Andrés. Happy hour daily 4–6pm ($13 margaritas, bites from $4).

restaurants.name: Esther's Kitchen
restaurants.hours: MICHELIN official page: Mon–Fri 11:00am–3:00pm & 5:00pm–11:00pm; Sat–Sun 10:00am–3:00pm & 5:00pm–11:00pm.
restaurants.cost_2_adults_usd: 70–130 (verified menu: pastas $18–36, sandwiches $17–19; LVA: charcuterie $23 + budino $8 + wine → meal for 2 under $100)
restaurants.notes: Seasonal Italian, James Beard-nominated chef James Trees.

restaurants.name: YEN Viet Kitchen
restaurants.hours: Mon, Wed–Sun 10:00am–9:00pm; closed Tuesday (VegasNearMe + Wanderlog agree). Tripadvisor lists 10:00am–7:00pm — conflict, flagged.
restaurants.cost_2_adults_usd: 30–60 (verified menu: bun mam $14, mi quang $11, goi cuon $6, salads $10)
restaurants.notes: Off-Strip Vietnamese; no alcohol per menupix listing.

restaurants.name: Anima by EDO
restaurants.hours: Official site: dinner nightly 5:00pm, last reservation 8:45pm; weekday lunch Mon–Fri 11:00am–2:00pm.
restaurants.cost_2_adults_usd: 80–170 (verified menu: tapas $8–28, pasta $24–29, entrées $36–45; Anima Experience tasting $85 pp +$65 pairing)
restaurants.notes: Off-Strip southwest; vegan/vegetarian tasting menus on request.

restaurants.name: Bouchon
restaurants.hours: Official Thomas Keller site: dinner Sun–Sat 5:00–10:00pm; brunch Thu 8:00am–1:00pm, Fri–Sun 8:00am–2:00pm.
restaurants.cost_2_adults_usd: 150–250 (LVA price band $75–125 pp; entrees below $30 historically, steak frites ~$31)
restaurants.notes: Thomas Keller French bistro; separate Bouchon Bakery open daily 6:00am–2:00pm.

restaurants.name: COTE Korean Steakhouse
restaurants.address: 3355 S Las Vegas Blvd (Venetian, Restaurant Row)
restaurants.hours: Official site: Sun–Thu 5:00pm–11:00pm; Fri–Sat 4:30pm–12:00am (site also shows a Sun–Wed 5–11 / Thu–Sat 5–12 variant — minor internal conflict, flagged).
restaurants.cost_2_adults_usd: 178+ (Butcher's Feast $88.88 pp = ~$178 for 2; steak omakase $225 pp; filet mignon $78)
restaurants.notes: NYC Michelin-starred brand; Las Vegas location opened Oct 2025. Note: the LV venue itself is MICHELIN Guide listed, not starred.

restaurants.name: Estiatorio Milos
restaurants.address: 3355 S Las Vegas Blvd (Venetian, Restaurant Row)
restaurants.hours: CONFLICT — SmarterVegas/DimHour: Sun–Thu 11:30am–11:00pm, Fri–Sat 11:30am–11:30pm; Las Vegas Advisor: closed Sundays, lunch Mon–Sat 12–3pm, dinner Mon–Thu 5–10pm / Fri–Sat 5–11pm. Verify on estiatoriomilos.com.
restaurants.cost_2_adults_usd: 220–380 dinner (third-party); 3-course lunch $45 pp (official promo through 2026-12-31)
restaurants.notes: Greek seafood; whole fish at market price.

restaurants.name: Gymkhana
restaurants.hours: Official ARIA/MGM press: Sun–Thu 5:00–10:00pm, Fri–Sat 5:00–10:30pm. (myrsvp listing shows 5:00–11:00pm weekdays — conflict, flagged.)
restaurants.cost_2_adults_usd: 100–350 (verified: mains $28–75, sides $18–25, chaat $22; $165 tasting menu per Eater)
restaurants.notes: London 2-Michelin-star brand, first US location (opened Dec 2025) at ARIA. Guests must be 6+; business-casual. Reservations via SevenRooms/ARIA concierge — official standalone URL not captured, flagged.

restaurants.name: Kabuto
restaurants.hours: MICHELIN official page: daily 5:30–9:00pm (seatings 5:30 & 7:30pm per third-party).
restaurants.notes: Edomae sushi omakase. Cost for 2 NOT VERIFIED — no reliable price found; flagged unverified.

restaurants.name: Kame Omakase
restaurants.hours: MICHELIN official page: daily 5:30–10:00pm (seatings ~6:00–8:00 & 8:30–10:30pm per third-party).
restaurants.cost_2_adults_usd: 600 (≈$300 pp, joinpearl listing Nov 2026)
restaurants.notes: 10-seat omakase room; books out weeks ahead.

restaurants.name: Lamaii
restaurants.hours: Yelp (Nov 2026): Mon–Wed 11:00am–12:00am, Thu–Sun 11:00am–2:00am.
restaurants.cost_2_adults_usd: 40–80 (verified menu: panang crispy duck $22, gang rawaeng $15, tom yum $11, honey toast $9)
restaurants.notes: Thai + wine bar. No official website captured — flagged.

restaurants.name: MICHAEL MINA Bellagio
restaurants.hours: CONFLICT — OpenTable (official listing): Tue–Sat 5:00–9:30pm; Las Vegas Advisor: Tue–Sat 5:30–10:00pm. Closed Sun–Mon. Verify on Bellagio's site.
restaurants.cost_2_adults_usd: 500–590 (10-course seasonal tasting $295 pp Autumn Harvest Oct 2026 / $250 pp High Summer; caviar supplement $55, wagyu supplement $69)
restaurants.notes: Tasting menu times Wed–Sat 5:00–9:30pm per Las Vegas Magazine (Oct 2026).

restaurants.name: Mott 32
restaurants.address: 3325 S Las Vegas Blvd (Palazzo casino floor)
restaurants.hours: Official site: lunch Mon–Fri 11:00am–2:30pm; dinner daily 5:00–10:00pm; Brunch 32 Sat–Sun 10:30am–2:30pm.
restaurants.cost_2_adults_usd: 240–380 (third-party dinner-for-2 range; verified: Peking duck $130–148, dim sum $16–24, mains $48–95)
restaurants.notes: Applewood-roasted Peking duck must be pre-ordered 24h ahead.

restaurants.name: Partage
restaurants.hours: Tue–Sat 5:30–9:30pm; closed Mon & Sun (OpenTable + Yelp agree).
restaurants.cost_2_adults_usd: 260–420 — OFFICIAL menu fetched 2026-11-25: 5-course $130 pp, 7-course $160 pp, Signature $210 pp; wine pairings $60/$84/$108 pp; foie add-on +$33
restaurants.notes: Tasting-menu-only modern French; menus change monthly (surprise courses). Earlier sources showing $80/$100/$130 and $120/$150/$198 were outdated — official menu now $130/$160/$210 (conflict B9 resolved 2026-11-25).

restaurants.name: Pho Ga Bac Bac
restaurants.hours: CONFLICT — Yelp: open 24 hours daily; MICHELIN page: Mon/Wed–Sun 12:00am–12:00am but Tue 7:30am–11:30pm. Verify before late-night visits.
restaurants.cost_2_adults_usd: 30–60 (verified menu: grilled lemongrass chicken $14.98, spring rolls $13.73)
restaurants.notes: Northern-style chicken pho specialty. No official website captured — flagged.

restaurants.name: Ping Pang Pong
restaurants.hours: MICHELIN official page: daily 10:00am–3:00am. LVA detail: dim sum lunch 10:00am–3:00pm, dinner 5:00pm–3:00am.
restaurants.cost_2_adults_usd: 30–60 (LVA dim sum bill for two $31.16 — note: LVA prices may be dated; cart categories $2.18–5.88 historically)
restaurants.notes: Cart-style dim sum, 90+ items; late-night dining till 3am. Official Gold Coast URL not captured; price source dated — flagged.

restaurants.name: SoulBelly BBQ
restaurants.hours: Official site: Tue–Thu 11:00am–9:00pm, Fri–Sat 11:00am–10:00pm, Sun 11:00am–9:00pm; closed Monday (Monday closure from secondary sources — official page omits Mondays).
restaurants.cost_2_adults_usd: 30–60 (verified menu: brisket $21, Belly of Soul sandwich $23.50, BBQ basics $18.75, sides $6–11.50)
restaurants.notes: Also SoulBelly Express at Miracle Mile Eats food court (daily 10:00am–9/10pm).

restaurants.name: Sparrow + Wolf
restaurants.hours: Dinner daily 5:00–10:00pm (OpenTable official listing). Third-party says 4:30–10:00pm — minor conflict, flagged.
restaurants.cost_2_adults_usd: 140–210 à la carte for 2 (third-party); Chef's Tasting Menu $142 pp (OpenTable experience) → ~$284 for 2
restaurants.notes: Chef Brian Howard (James Beard semifinalist); happy hour Mon–Fri at bar.

restaurants.name: Stubborn Seed
restaurants.hours: Official/OpenTable: bar daily 4:00–10:00pm; dinner daily 5:00–10:00pm.
restaurants.cost_2_adults_usd: 290–350 (8–10 course tasting $145–175 pp; wine pairing +$70 pp)
restaurants.notes: Top Chef winner Jeremy Ford. Tasting-menu special $145 pp through 2026-12-31 (SmarterVegas).

restaurants.name: Wing Lei
restaurants.address: 3131 S Las Vegas Blvd (Wynn Las Vegas)
restaurants.hours: CONFLICT — SmarterVegas + joinpearl: Sun/Mon/Thu 5:30–9:30pm, Fri–Sat 5:30–10:00pm, CLOSED Tue–Wed; Las Vegas Advisor: Sun–Thu 5:30–9:30pm (implies open Tue–Wed). Two sources say closed Tue–Wed.
restaurants.cost_2_adults_usd: 176–400 (Imperial Peking Duck tasting $88 pp = $176 for 2; third-party dinner-for-2 range $250–400)
restaurants.notes: First Chinese restaurant in North America to earn a Michelin star (historical). Official Wynn URL not captured — flagged.
